articles.title: Qwen-Image-3.0: Native Multimodal Creation
articles.content:
Qwen-Image-3.0

Qwen-Image-3.0 introduces native image generation and editing in one model. It improves prompt following, text rendering, and multi-image consistency for practical creative workflows.

The release is available through Qwen services and includes deployment guidance for developers evaluating production use.

extra.author: Qwen Team
extra.description: Native image generation and editing in one model.

articles.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next: More Reliable Agents
articles.content:
Qwen3-Coder-Next

Qwen3-Coder-Next improves repository-scale coding, tool selection, and recovery from failed actions. The update targets longer software-engineering tasks and more predictable agent behavior.

extra.description: A coding-model update focused on reliable agent workflows.
